risk_if_not_implemented: Without Insider Threats, trusted insiders may misuse access or act on conflicts of interest without detection or deterrence. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to System / Data Compromise (Non-Technical Vector) (R-BC-5), Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to man-made threats MT-2, MT-8, MT-9, MT-10, MT-14, MT-15.

compensating_control_1.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Insider Threats (MON-17.3) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Behavioral Baselining
compensating_control_2.description: Automated mechanisms exist to establish behavioral baselines that capture information about user and entity behavior to enable dynamic threat discovery.
compensating_control_2.justification: Behavioral Baselining (THR-09) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Insider Threats (MON-17.3) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
